messages:
maria (support): Heads up — multiple customers reporting 502 / gateway timeouts for hosted inference in us-west-2 starting ~08:03 UTC. Spike in error-rate ~25% on the public API. Creating war room.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DECLARED: hosted-inference-gateway-degraded us-west-2 — severity: high — incident-channel: #incidents
ashok (eng-sre): On it. Initial glance at LB metrics shows increased upstream resets from runtime-proxy nodes at 08:02. CPU looks normal, but connection resets went up.
ashok (eng-sre): Pushed a quick alert to scale pool but holding on changes until we confirm root cause.
dana (runtime): Seeing repeat of this log in the proxy:
```
[2026-01-18T08:03:12Z] proxy error: 502 Bad Gateway - upstream_reset on connection id=0x7fa2
KV_CACHE_MISS count spike: 4.8x
```
jon (customer): We're getting 504s and call latencies > 7s. A batch job retries and ends up throttled. This is impacting our SLA.
maria (support): Jon — apologies. We're investigating. Can you share a sample request id? (I have been collecting a few via support logs.)
jon (customer): sample request-id: req_88f3a2b7 ; endpoint: POST /v1/generate
ashok (eng-sre): Reproduced a repro locally against hosted endpoint with a curl sequence — intermittently returns 502. Quick repro:
```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}' -w "\n%{http_code}\n" ; done
```
ashok (eng-sre): When I hit the gateway with high concurrency, about 1 in 6 requests get 502 and the proxy logs show upstream connection resets. Candidate hypothesis: connection exhaustion / pool sizing regression after last runtime-proxy config change.
dana (runtime): I just checked the deploy history — a config tweak to proxy keepalive and max-conns was rolled 2 hours before incident (canary at 06:00). Rolling back to previous values now.
ashok (eng-sre): Rolling restart initiated for proxy fleet in us-west-2: `rdctl rollout restart proxy --region us-west-2 --reason "gateway-502 spike"` ; monitoring.
lena (product): Noted customer impact. What's mitigation plan if rollback doesn't help?
dana (runtime): If rollback fails, we will route hosted traffic to us-east-1 as temporary failover and enable degraded mode (no large-batch requests) to reduce stress. I'll prepare failover steps.
ashok (eng-sre): Also temporarily increasing per-tenant concurrency caps via rate-limit overrides to smooth traffic: `ratelimit set --scope hosted-us-west-2 --concurrency 16` ; this should reduce bursts.
maria (support): Communicating to affected customers (ticket links) and offering credits where SLAs breached. Zia, can you pre-authorize emergency credits for impacted customers if postmortem shows >2% calls dropped?
zia (billing): Affirmative. Trigger emergency credit path. Need list of affected customers and rough token counts; support please collate.
maria (support): Will compile and send in 30min.
incident-bot: status update: rollback applied to proxy config at 08:18 UTC; rolling restarts completed by 08:22 UTC.
ashok (eng-sre): After restart, error-rate dropped to baseline ~1.5% and most downstream 502s went away. Still seeing 502s for very large prompt sizes (seq > 8k). Looking into kernel-level OOMs on a couple of old nodes.
dana (runtime): Isolating two older GPU nodes with older drivers — cordoning them and draining workloads now: `rdctl node cordon node-45 node-46` ; migration in progress.
jon (customer): Error volume reduced on our side. Thanks — we'll keep monitoring. Could you share a root cause when you have it?
lena (product): Filing a postmortem ticket. We'll want clear comms: timeline, mitigation, and action items (including config gating, canary thresholds, and alert tuning).
ashok (eng-sre): Preliminary root cause: the proxy change to lower keepalive and higher per-connection concurrency combined with older nodes caused more upstream resets and connection churn; exposed a driver-level edge-case on older GPUs leading to slowed KV-cache priming and mid-request failures.
ashok (eng-sre): Root cause hypothesis still being validated — collecting more runtime traces and kernel logs. Planning to repro in staging with same config + old node image.
dana (runtime): Temporary mitigations we applied:
- rolled back proxy config to previous keepalive/max-conns (owner: dana)
- rolling restart of proxy fleet in us-west-2 (owner: ashok)
- cordoned 2 older gpu nodes (owner: dana)
- lowered per-tenant concurrency via rate-limit override (owner: ashok)
- prepared failover plan to us-east-1 if recurrence (owner: dana)

Action items (post-incident):
- ashok: validate staged repro and confirm root cause (due: 2026-01-20)
- dana: gate proxy config changes behind e2e canary that simulates high-concurrency short requests (due: 2026-01-22)
- infra: create automated rolling-restart runbook for proxy with safety checks (ticket: INF-2345) (owner: eng-infra)
- product/lena + support/maria: prepare customer communication and SLA impact calc (due: 2026-01-19)
- zia (billing): prepare emergency credit runbook and thresholds (due: 2026-01-21)
- ops: add alert for KV_CACHE_MISS rate x baseline and upstream_reset rate (alert config change) (owner: ashok)

maria (support): I'll update affected customers now and attach the ticket list.
jon (customer): Thanks for the quick response team — appreciate the transparency. We'll watch for the postmortem.
ashok (eng-sre): Will post a final RCA once validated. For now, monitoring looks green in us-west-2 and error-rate is back to expected.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (degraded) — root-cause: under investigation; status: postmortem required. Close channel when follow-ups tracked.
